# Google Material Icons

Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; the complete license is included in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4

Both `base/media` and `dark/media` variants use the same Material Icons Outlined 24 px geometry, except for `icon_home.svg`. Homowarden changes only the root dimensions and theme color of the Material assets. Original vector paths are preserved. The filled favorite is the upstream filled-star state supplied by that icon family. No Bitwarden-owned vector paths are included.

`icon_home.svg` is an original Homowarden safe-door icon, independently drawn using a square frame and circular dial. It is covered by Homowarden's MIT license and is not derived from Material Icons or Bitwarden artwork.
